Pakistan Army Warns of Action Over Indus Water Treaty Share

The Pakistan Army chief has stated that "necessary measures" will be taken to protect Pakistan's share of water under the Indus Water Treaty. This statement comes amid ongoing discussions and potential disputes regarding water allocation between India and Pakistan. The warning highlights the sensitivity of water resources as a point of contention between the two nations.
